monitoringConfig.restartHint: Changes here apply to the current process only (in-memory hot update); a restart falls back to the configuration file. Edit the config file for a permanent change.
monitoringConfig.noConfig: Monitoring config not loaded yet. Please refresh.
monitoringConfig.enabledHint: When disabled, no metrics are collected and the related charts stop updating.
monitoringConfig.prefixHint: Must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and underscores.
monitoringConfig.samplingHint: A number between 0 and 1; 1 collects everything. Lower rates reduce overhead but scale the statistics down.
monitoringConfig.performanceHint: The buffer must be at least as large as the batch size; changes do not affect in-flight collection and revert on restart.
monitoringConfig.invalidPrefix: Metric prefix must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and underscores
monitoringConfig.invalidInterval: Collection interval must be greater than 0 seconds
monitoringConfig.invalidSampling: Sampling rates must be between 0 and 1
monitoringConfig.invalidBuffer: Buffer size must be at least the batch size
